The '''Belugans''' were a [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|crystalline]]-aquatic [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]].

==Biology and appearance==
Belugans were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] notable for their tentacled mouths divided in four separated parts.<ref name=":0" /> Their eyes rolled back white when showing attack expressions.<ref name=":4">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep420|text="Bounty" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
The Belugans, who had wealth and technology on their side,<ref name=":1" /> did show some martial arts, as [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Rigosso/Legends|Rigosso]] was seen giving a butterfly kick to an incoming Kage Warrior.<ref name=":0" />

==History==
[[File:QuarziteCaves-Bounty.png|left|thumb|250x250px|The caves of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]], the Belugans' home.]]
Belugans were native to [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]],<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Due to the inhospitable atmospheric pressure on the surface of Quarzite, the Belugan and [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] people lived in subterranean passages beneath the planet's crust.<ref name=":3" /> Its inhospitable nature prevented it from truly flourishing as part of the galactic community.<ref name="SWE-Quarzite">{{SWE|locations|quarzite|Quarzite}}</ref> Transit and transportation for the Belugans were provided by a series of subtram lines.<ref name=":3">{{SWE|characters|majorrigosso|Major Rigosso}}</ref> By the years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Lord [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] ruled the small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with an iron fist.<ref name=":2">{{SWE|characters|otuablank|Otua Blank}}</ref> [[File:Unidentified_Belugan_guard_2.png|thumb|250x250px|A Belugan dressed in protective suit.]]
An ongoing conflict between the outnumbered [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] and the powerful Belugans, who had wealth and technology on their side,<ref name=":1">{{SWE|groups|kagewarriors|Kage Warriors}}</ref> had been going by the times of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In this conflict the [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] could keep pace with the subtram transports that supplied Blank's strongholds,<ref name=":0" /> and launch raids that caught the Belugan security forces off-guard.<ref name=":1" /> Blank had marshaled an elite military force that protected his domain, but that weren't skilled enough to deal with the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage warriors]].<ref name=":2" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Bounty Date">{{FactFile2014|57|DEN 1-2|Dengar}}</ref> [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] kidnapped [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]], sister of the leader of [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]], to make her his bride. A group of mercenaries, including [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], was assembled to deliver the girl, closed in a box, to Blank's stronghold. In the [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|ensuing mission]] Ventress liberated Pluma and delivered her to his brother, leaving instead at Blank a tied up [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
The four-part mouth of the Belugans was based on the mouth structure and baleen of a [[Whale (disambiguation)|whale]].<ref name=":4" />
